class.name: NNBTRunHostedRoot
class.brief_description: Runs a root nested below the leaf as its own hosted root.
class.description: Activates every root child when its run starts and deactivates them when the run ends or is interrupted, so a nested [NNBTRoot], [NNSTRoot] or [NNAgent] is driven by this leaf instead of by its own scheduler. The roots are ticked with this leaf's tick delta. Returns [constant NNBTNodes.RUNNING] until a hosted root reports finished, then matches that report with [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS] or [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE]. A completion that happens inside the same tick is reported by that tick. Only the first completion of a run is recorded; later ones are ignored. A hosted [NNAgent] never reports finished, so the leaf keeps returning [constant NNBTNodes.RUNNING] until it is interrupted or reset. This leaf is fully data-driven: it is configured by its root children and does not call an [code]on_tick[/code] override in an attached script. The editor reports a configuration warning when the leaf has no root child.
